 print(obj['name'],'count',len(triangles),'bounds',vertices.min(0).tolist(),vertices.max(0).tolist(),'normals',np.unique(normals,axis=0).tolist())
 print('ordered_geometry_sha256_json',hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({'vertices':obj['vertices'],'triangles':obj['triangles']},separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest())
 if obj is far:
